notes: Make the ROS builder yours, and the caller follows. View ▾ › Columns… shows, hides and orders the columns (or drag a heading across the grid); Text size A− / A+ (80–160%); Light or dark: light for a bright office, in StandBy's own warm colours. The columns, their widths, the text size and the theme are saved in the show, and Load into Caller opens the caller the same way (its clocks and cards stay as they were). A new running order starts from the last layout used; undo never touches it. Review shows the department calls: each row writes out every department's entry (*LIGHTING Dims to 50%*),…
